summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) end-to-end: implement vault blob v2 binary format across core, API, Rust desktop, and web client, with lazy migration for existing users. Ship the PR and pass CI.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed and verified (6/6 VAULT requirements). PR #344 created, all 8 CodeRabbit review comments resolved, and CI failures fixed. Phase 23 (Rust SDK Extraction) added to roadmap as a follow-on.

repo: NestJS doesn't auto-log incoming request routes, so POST /vault/migrate appeared to have never been called when in fact it succeeded at 00:12:38 UTC — confirming migrations via DB query is necessary

orval v7.18.0 generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` for nullable string fields even when the OpenAPI spec correctly has `type: string, nullable: true` — `as unknown as string` casts are the correct workaround until orval is upgraded

The IPFS gateway at 192.168.133.114:8080 exposes `/ipns/{name}` path resolution with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, but the Kubo API at port 5001 lacks CORS headers — browser-side IPNS resolution must use the gateway /ipns/ path, not the API
Subfolder IPNS records are only stored in the CipherBox API DB cache and not propagated to the public DHT, meaning the recovery tool can only traverse root-level folders in a fully offline scenario
The vault.service.ts branch coverage threshold is 77% — new service methods must include branch tests for nullable path handling (?.toString('hex') ?? null) to avoid CI failures

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parses IPFS blob bytes — must check for v2 binary format header and strip it before parsing, or v2 vaults crash sync with SyntaxError
SDK version of fetchAndDecryptMetadata had same v2 blob parsing bug as web folder.service.ts
fetchFromIpfs can return undefined on non-404 gateway errors (502/503) — calling detectBlobVersion(undefined) crashes; must guard with explicit undefined check and throw
serialize_vault_blob_v2 originally returned Vec<u8> with no bounds checking — key length can silently truncate to u16 max; function now returns Result with explicit > 65535 error
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse derived Debug — this leaks ECIES-encrypted key material in logs; replaced with custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields
Migration IIFE called deriveVaultIpnsKeypair() twice with identical inputs and wrapped ipnsKeypair into an identical redundant object before passing it
Desktop vault init was ECIES-wrapping rootFolderKey twice with the same public key — once for DB storage and once for v2 blob; reuses the first wrap
Mock vault entity was missing migratedAt field — caused toVaultResponse assertion to fail after the field was added to the real entity

workflow: When API server doesn't log request routes, always confirm endpoint execution via direct DB query rather than relying on absence of log lines

Security review (custom skill) ran mid-phase at the checkpoint, found 2 HIGH issues (key bounds checking, Debug impl leakage), and fixed them before verification — catching these during UAT rather than post-merge
The /gsd:debug workflow correctly identified the 'silent failure' was actually a silent success by querying the database directly rather than relying on log inference

Recovery tool IPNS resolution required multiple iterations: delegated routing returned CBOR not raw protobuf → switched to JSON Accept header → gateway /ipns/ HEAD request extracting X-Ipfs-Roots header was the final working approach
Playwright browser automation was essential for real-time OTP retrieval, console log inspection, and end-to-end verification of the migration flow without manual browser interaction

friction: NestJS not logging request routes caused significant debugging time investigating a migration that had already succeeded
orval codegen bug means nullable string DTO fields require `as unknown as string` casts indefinitely until orval is upgraded — added noise to Copilot review
Kubo IPFS API port 5001 lacks CORS headers, blocking browser-side IPNS resolution and requiring multiple fallback iterations in the recovery tool before finding the gateway /ipns/ path approach
Subfolder IPNS records not propagated to public DHT means recovery tool can only fully traverse root folders — limits UAT to partial verification
API branch coverage threshold failure required two separate fix rounds: first adding migrateVault tests, then discovering nullable column branches still uncovered
open_items: Recovery tool: private key (rootFolderKey) not zeroed from memory after use (Medium security finding M-1)
No deduplication guard for concurrent vault migration triggers from multiple browser tabs (Medium security finding M-2)
ECIES re-wrap on every root folder FUSE publish is redundant — should cache wrapped key in AppState (Medium security finding M-3)
Recovery tool: no SRI hashes on CDN scripts in recovery.html (Low security finding L-2)
Subfolder IPNS records need DHT propagation strategy for recovery tool to traverse full folder trees

Phase 23: Rust SDK Extraction — extract shared cipherbox-core crate mirroring @cipherbox/core and @cipherbox/sdk-core, replace duplicated crypto/IPNS/metadata logic in FUSE code, enable unit testing at same granularity as TypeScript
E2E tests for vault v2 recovery tool (.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-24-add-e2e-tests-for-vault-v2-recovery-tool.md)
Fix device registry CryptoError: Invalid registry format — schema mismatch in validateDeviceEntry (core/dist/index.mjs:360)
Fix /ipns/resolve 404 for bin IPNS name resolution failures
